# Auto-Generated Pickup Instructions

## Problem
Store associates spend time answering drivers who cannot find the pickup counter (source: LMD store operations survey).

## Proposal
Generate store-specific pickup instructions from past pickup photos and show them in the driver app.

## Success Metrics
- Cost Per Delivery: from $7.40 to $7.25 within 10 weeks.

## Guardrail Metrics
- Delivery Defect Rate: stop if it rises by more than 0.2 points.

## Experiment Plan
Run a pilot in the markets whose managers volunteer and compare against the remaining markets. Duration: 3 weeks. MDE: 1 point, power 80%. Primary metric and stopping rule pre-registered.

## Reviews And Dependencies
Store systems team to provide the photo archive.
